identity.purpose: Reproduce the #1465 5 October reconciliation failure as observed evidence; no invented ground truth.

origin.note: Public aggregates only, as published on the issue by the installation owner. No raw samples, no historical configuration.

data_semantics.resolution: hourly means of five-minute statistics; daily counter deltas
data_semantics.pack_vs_charger: EV pack power and DC charger energy are different measurement boundaries and are not compared as equal

observed._note: As published on #1465 (comment 6016381858). Counters are the Sigenergy grid import and export energy counters, MWh converted to kWh; 25 contiguous hourly records, no decrease. The five-minute directional grid-power integration is the second, independent meter reading on the same comment.

expected.reproduces: reconstructed site exchange disagrees with the meter; scoring must be marked unreliable or reconcile

verdict._note: DC-003 decisions 1 and 2 applied as proposed: tolerance max(2 kWh, 10 % of metered throughput); the meter's declared sign (a directional counter pair declares itself); both signs tried only for a legacy binding with none.

comparison.rounded_fields: within half the last displayed decimal (rounding only, not physical agreement)

privacy.publication: public aggregates already on the issue; richer capture deferred pending the owner's approval
